checks: Every benchmark.json full_id equals a reviewed source name; no missing or additional case.
Each sample has exactly20 times and20 iteration counts; every value positive and finite.
Mean recomputed as arithmetic mean of sample time/iterations matches raw mean estimate within1e-14 relative tolerance.
Each measurements.json mean, mean confidence interval and total iteration count matches raw estimates/sample; mean bounds finite, positive and ordered.
Mean confidence intervals are not per-event latency p95/p99; console time output may represent regression slope rather than the JSON mean.

provenance.host_load: Build/start and measurement host loads recorded; no claim of exclusive-host benchmark isolation.

limits: Six local component-harness observations only; fixed-batch/output movement, instrumentation, validation and actual wrapper behavior contribute to measured values. Setup is outside per-batch timing but contributes wall-clock/calibration cost.
Full rejection cases perform different validation; no isolated push/wrapper ratio, speedup, allocation count, latency percentile, threshold compliance or whole-engine tracing-on/off claim.
No whole-master performance acceptance, formal proof, full CI closure or live ledger/checker approval. FramePool correctness is outside this execution audit.
No benchmark/native rerun, source/gate/tracker edits, agents or other review-report reads. Only this requested report written.
